flows.name: classify_service_request
steps: resolve SR Customer from accepted ticket/reference authority
enumerate only CPLs whose Contract belongs to that Customer
apply deterministic trusted mapping where uniquely sufficient
otherwise stage reviewed selection with eligible/incompatible/stale/unresolved partitions
commit one independently auditable classification result per accepted target
recompute live individual/cohort projections without changing completed reports

flows.name: calculate_individual_sla
steps: require accepted Report Date and compatible CPL policy
resolve endpoint: current canonical instant when active, first accepted effective Resolved/Closed when terminal eligible
sum only accepted source-reported suspension
compute max(0, endpoint - Report Date - suspension) in exact whole-second/integer-or-decimal arithmetic
derive current individual state from applicable policy tier
retain uncalculable/unknown explicitly rather than guessing

flows.name: build_monthly_cohort
steps: select eligible non-Cancelled SRs by accepted Report Date month in America/Guayaquil
partition by Customer, Contract, CPL, severity and policy tier
compute individual current/final eligibility and denominator/numerator bounds
derive Pending/Currently Met/At Risk/Breached/Final Met under accepted rules
never include derived compliance outcome in cohort identity
keep open-month states non-final

flows.name: revise_policy_or_classification
steps: append/activate new policy revision or reviewed SR classification
recompute current individual/cohort projections from accepted facts
preserve all previous policy/classification history
leave completed report evidence unchanged

flows.name: complete_report
steps: open one consistent accepted-state read boundary with exact as-of/scope
resolve cohort membership, policy revisions, classifications and calculations inside that boundary
generate artifact from the same represented state
verify artifact completion/integrity
only then publish immutable CompletedReportEvidence
failed/cancelled generation retains bounded attempt history and mutates no operational truth
